description:
Run skip tracing to find owners and their phone numbers, emails and mailing addresses.
- property_ids: find the owner of saved properties (creates/links owner records)
- owner_ids: refresh contact details for existing owners

Costs enrichment credits per record (check spur_get_billing_summary). Ask the user to approve the count first, then call with confirm=true.

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after the user explicitly approved this exact action in the conversation. Never assume approval.

property_ids.description: Saved property ids whose owners to skip-trace
